entries.title: Refract from Height
entries.summary: Refracts an image through a height layer.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the source accepts. See [Signatures|/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Filter
parameters.description: The method used to sample the source image. The default value is `Box`. See [Filters|/copernicus/glossary#filter] for more information.

parameters.label: Normal Type
parameters.description: The format of the normal input. This is available when the normal input is wired. See [Normals|/copernicus/normals] for more information.

parameters.label: Directional
parameters.description: Use a directional view ray. When this is off, the node uses a point view position.

parameters.label: View Azimuth
parameters.description: The horizontal angle of the directional view ray.

parameters.label: View Altitude
parameters.description: The vertical angle of the directional view ray above the horizon.

parameters.label: View Position
parameters.description: The point view position in the selected space.

parameters.label: Index of Refraction
parameters.heading: Height
parameters.description: The index of refraction of the transparent medium. The default value of 1.33 approximates water.

parameters.label: Height Offset
parameters.heading: Height
parameters.description: The value to add to the height layer before tracing rays. If the normal input is wired without a height input, this sets the flat surface height.

parameters.label: Height Scale
parameters.heading: Height
parameters.description: The value to multiply the height layer by before tracing rays. This is disabled when a normal input is wired.

parameters.label: Compute Derivative outside Image
parameters.heading: Height
parameters.description: Allows the internal derivative calculation for the height surface to read outside the image bounds. This affects the surface normals used for refraction.

parameters.label: Kernel Size
parameters.heading: Height
parameters.description: The kernel size for the internal derivative calculation on the height surface.

parameters.label: Index of Refraction
parameters.heading: Ground
parameters.description: The index of refraction of the medium below the ground surface. The default value of 1.0 approximates air.

parameters.label: Ground Offset
parameters.heading: Ground
parameters.description: The value to add to the ground height before tracing ray intersections.

parameters.label: Ground Scale
parameters.heading: Ground
parameters.description: The value to multiply the ground height by before tracing ray intersections.

parameters.label: Ray Trace Iterations
parameters.heading: Ground
parameters.description: The number of Newton iterations used to approximate where refracted view rays intersect the ground height layer.

parameters.label: Compute Derivative outside Image
parameters.heading: Ground
parameters.description: Allows the internal derivative calculation for the ground layer to read outside the image bounds. This affects the ray-ground intersection solve.

parameters.label: Kernel Size
parameters.heading: Ground
parameters.description: The kernel size for the internal derivative calculation on the ground layer.

parameters.label: Material
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The transparent material used for spectral dispersion and absorbance. Use a higher Number of Colors value for smoother dispersion.

parameters.label: Medium Color
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The tint color of the transparent medium.

parameters.label: Light Absorbance
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: Controls how much light is absorbed as rays travel through the medium. Higher values make deeper or longer paths darker and more affected by the medium's material and color.

parameters.label: Dispersion
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The amount of spectral dispersion. Higher values increase color separation.

parameters.label: Number of Colors
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The number of wavelength samples used for dispersion. Higher values create smoother dispersion, but take longer to cook.

parameters.label: Strength
parameters.heading: Reflection
parameters.description: The strength of the reflected environment.

parameters.label: Bias
parameters.heading: Reflection
parameters.description: Controls the distribution of the reflection. Lower values spread the reflection more broadly across the surface, while higher values concentrate it near stronger Fresnel highlights.

parameters.label: Color
parameters.heading: Reflection
parameters.description: The tint color of the reflection.

parameters.label: Saturation Scale
parameters.heading: Reflection
parameters.description: Multiplies the saturation of the reflected environment.

parameters.label: Environment Map Offset
parameters.heading: Reflection
parameters.description: Rotates the environment map projection used for reflection and refracted background lookup.

entries.title: Remap
entries.summary: Remaps a layer, VDB, or attribute.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the source accepts. See [Signatures|/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Mask
parameters.description: The amount of the new value to mix in with the original value. Higher values mix in more of the new value. Lower values mix in less of the new value. You can also set the RGBA [channels|Wp:Channel_(digital_image)] to which you apply the effects of this node. The default value is `1`, which means this node uses only the new value. See [Mask|/copernicus/glossary#mask] for more information.

parameters.label: Operation
parameters.description: The method used to remap the layer, VDB, or attribute.

parameters.label: Compute Range
parameters.description: Sets the __Input Min__ and __Input Max__ parameters to the minimum and maximum values of the `source` input.

parameters.label: Input Min
parameters.description: When __Operation__ is `Remap`, values lesser than or equal to this value are remapped to be __Output Min__.

parameters.label: Input Max
parameters.description: When __Operation__ is `Remap`, values greater than or equal to this value are remapped to be __Output Max__.

parameters.label: Threshold When
parameters.description: When __Operation__ is `Threshold`, this determines whether to remap values that're higher than, lower than, or equal to the threshold.

parameters.label: Threshold
parameters.description: When __Operation__ is `Threshold`, this is the value of the input range that maps to the midpoint of the output range. A __Threshold__ of `0.5` with a __Width__ of `0.0` represents an input range of (`0.5,0.5`).

parameters.label: Width
parameters.description: When __Operation__ is `Threshold`, this is the range on both sides of the threshold that determines the input minimum and maximum. A __Threshold__ of `0.5` with a __Width__ of `0.2` represents an input range of (`0.4,0.6`).

parameters.label: Output Min
parameters.description: The lower end of the output range.

parameters.label: Output Max
parameters.description: The higher end of the output range.

parameters.label: Outside Range
parameters.description: When __Operation__ is `Remap`, this determines how to treat values outside of the input range (__Input Min__ and __Input Max__).

parameters.label: Use Ramp
parameters.description: Applies the __Ramp__ parameter and any connected `ramp` input.

parameters.label: Ramp
parameters.description: A mono ramp that shapes the remapped output. See [Ramp parameters|/network/ramps] for more information.

entries.summary: End of a Ripple simulation block

parameters.label: Substeps
parameters.heading: Time
parameters.description: When simulation is on, each frame is divided into this number of substeps. Increasing the number of substeps improves simulation accuracy and can help maintain stability when high-speed ripples would otherwise cause instability.

parameters.label: Iterations
parameters.heading: Time
parameters.description: Amount of iterations to run in non-simulation mode.

parameters.label: NOTE
parameters.heading: Caching
parameters.description: When __Live Simulation__ is on, the __Start Frame__, __Cached Frames__, and __Checkpoint Rate__ parameters no longer apply.

parameters.label: Caching
parameters.heading: Caching
parameters.description: Turns on caching of frames.

parameters.label: Collision Threshold
parameters.heading: Wave Parameters
parameters.description: When the `collision` input is used, this value sets the threshold at which the mask acts as a collider.

parameters.label: Wave Speed
parameters.heading: Wave Parameters
parameters.description: Controls how fast the ripples travel from pixel to pixel. This is proportional to the change in image space when the buffer coordinate changes by one in either `x` or `y`.

parameters.label: Conservation
parameters.heading: Wave Parameters
parameters.description: Controls how much wave velocity is kept over time. It directly affects how quickly the motion slows down. A value of `1` means no velocity is lost. A value of `0.5` means half the velocity remains after one second. A value of `0` removes all motion immediately. Values outside the `0`–`1` range are not valid and will be clamped.

parameters.label: Spring
parameters.heading: Wave Parameters
parameters.description: Controls the strength of the spring force that pulls pixels toward their rest value. Wave motion is preserved by the wave speed, while the spring pulls values back toward the rest state. This can create additional ripples as the values settle.

entries.title: ROP Image
entries.summary: Writes the output of a COP network to disk.

parameters.label: Render to Disk
parameters.description: Saves the images to disk with the last control settings.

parameters.label: Render to MPlay
parameters.description: Renders the images to MPlay.

parameters.label: Render to Disk in Background
parameters.description: Starts another copy of Houdini in the background and instructs that copy to cook and save the images. This allows one to continue working and load the image files as they complete.

parameters.label: Valid Frame Range
parameters.description: Controls whether this render node outputs the current frame or the image sequence specified in the __Start/End/Inc__ parameters.

parameters.label: Start/End/Inc
parameters.description: Specifies the range of frames to render (start frame, end frame, and increment). All values may be floating point values. The range is inclusive. These parameters determine the values of the local variables for the output driver.

parameters.label: UDIM List
parameters.description: Controls range of UDIM tiles to render out. When not set to `Disabled`, the COP network is cooked with different UDIM context option values and the file saved. The <UDIM> token should be in the filename to save to different files for each tile.

parameters.label: Explicit UDIM List
parameters.description: This parameter controls which UDIM tiles are desired when __UDIM List__ is set to `Explicit`. Enter a space- or comma-separated list of individual tiles or linear ranges of tiles. For example, `1001 1009-1012,1025` corresponds to tiles 1001, 1009, 1010, 1011, 1012, 1025.

parameters.label: UDIM Range
parameters.description: When __UDIM List__ is set to `Range`, this parameter specifies the inclusive linear range of UDIM tiles that are desired.

parameters.label: Render with Take
parameters.description: Uses the settings in a particular take while rendering. Choose __Current__ to use the current take when rendering.

parameters.label: COP Path
parameters.description: The COP node, or COP subnet to render from.

parameters.label: Output File
parameters.description: File path to write the rendered images to. If this has a `<LAYER>` token, instead of many AOVs saving to a single file, the AOV name replaces the `<LAYER>` token and many files are saved. The `<F>` or `<F#>` token can be used to replace the current frame number with the token.  The `#` should be a number for the padding zeros to use. The `<UDIM>` token can be used to insert the currently processed UDIM into the file name.

parameters.label: Compiled Cook
parameters.description: Controls if the input nodes will be executed as a compiled block. Disabling through this toggle is a quick way to compare compiled and non-compiled behavior.

parameters.label: Set Default Resolution
parameters.description: Turn this on to specify a custom resolution to render at. If this is off, the node uses the COP node's resolution.

parameters.label: Default Resolution
parameters.description: Default resolution of rendered images used if the network doesn't have an explicit resolution. Copernicus networks `size_ref` inputs will default to the network's default resolution if unwired; this lets you override that value.  However if the resolution has been determined explicilty from a File COP or converting a volume from SOPs, no change will occur.   Use a Resample COP to force a specific resolution for output.

parameters.label: Set Default Pixel Scale
parameters.description: Turn this on to specify a custom pixel scale to render at. If this is off, the node uses the COP node's pixel scale.

parameters.label: Default Pixel Scale
parameters.description: Pixel scale of rendered images.

parameters.label: Set Default Border
parameters.description: Turn this on to specify a custom border to render with. If this is off, the node uses the COP node's border.

parameters.label: Default Border
parameters.description: Border of rendered images.

parameters.label: Set Default Precision
parameters.description: Turn this on to specify the precision to render with. If this is off, the node uses the COP node's precision.

parameters.label: Default Precision
parameters.description: Precision of rendered images.

parameters.label: Colorspace
parameters.description: When __Colorspace Conversion__ is __OpenColorIO Colorspace__, this is the output color space. The menu lists the color spaces from the OpenColorIO configuration file.

parameters.label: Look
parameters.description: When __Colorspace Conversion__ is __OpenColorIO Colorspace__, this is the OpenColorIO look to apply.

parameters.label: Display
parameters.description: When __Colorspace Conversion__ is __Bake to OpenColorIO Display/View__, this is the display to use.  If this is `Default`, the node uses the default display specified in the OpenColorIO configuration file.

parameters.label: View
parameters.description: When __Colorspace Conversion__ is __Bake to OpenColorIO Display/View__, this is the view for the display.  If this is `Default`, the node uses the default view for the specified display in the OpenColorIO configuration file.

parameters.label: Save Retries
parameters.description: If saving the image to disk fails due to a disk writing error, Houdini will usually error the output node immediately.  This is desirable for most cases where a failure to save means an illegal path, which is not recoverable.  However, sometimes files fail to save due to network issues.  If the number of save retries is non-zero, Houdini will re-attempt to save this number of times. Each time will be accompanied with an output to the console of the failure to save and a five second wait in the hopes that the network will clear up.

parameters.label: Reload All Files
parameters.description: Tell the Copernicus network to reload any cached files (for example, images loaded by the [File COP|Node:cop/file]).

parameters.label: Add AOVs from Input
parameters.heading: File Layout
parameters.description: Pressing this button will remove all existing AOVs and import each AOV from the specified input's outputs and set their properties appropriately.

parameters.label: AOV Name
parameters.heading: File Layout
parameters.description: The name of the COP output to write to disk.

parameters.label: Data Size
parameters.heading: File Layout
parameters.description: Data size of output AOV.

parameters.label: Raw
parameters.heading: File Layout
parameters.description: Don't perform any colorspace conversion on this AOV. When off, the node modifies the data if your working color space is different from the output color space (from scene linear into the rule that's assigned to the file format you're saving, per the OCIO settings).

parameters.label: Explicit Port
parameters.heading: File Layout
parameters.description: When enabled, allows you to explicity specify the output port index of the source COP.

parameters.label: Port
parameters.heading: File Layout
parameters.description: The output port index of the AOV on the source COP. If you add your AOVs in non-sequential order, you must use this parameter to specify the correct order. For instance, the AOVs in your source COP are `C`, `N`, `P`, and you add them to the Image ROP as `P`, `C`, `N`, you will need to set the port parameters to `2`, `0`, `1`, respectively.

parameters.label: Create Intermediate Directories
parameters.heading: Render Settings
parameters.description: When turned on, creates intermediate parent directories for output files as needed. Currently only applies to generated scripts, images, and shadow maps.

parameters.label: Initialize Simulation OPs
parameters.heading: Render Settings
parameters.description: Forces all simulation OPs to be reset. This includes DOP Networks, POP SOPs, and other OPs that cache their results. This is the safest way to render out a simulation, because it starts the simulation from scratch and discards any partial simulations you might have done with different parameters.

parameters.label: Alfred Style Progress
parameters.heading: Render Settings
parameters.description: A percentage complete value is printed out as files are written. This is in the style expected by Pixar's Alfred render queue.

parameters.label: Save in Background
parameters.heading: Render Settings
parameters.description: When saving more than one frame, save in a background thread. This can make saving faster for large file sizes, but may use more memory since it will retain the output image until the save completes.

parameters.label: Export Attributes
parameters.heading: Metadata
parameters.description: Writes out layer attributes as image metadata.

parameters.label: Attribute Filter
parameters.heading: Metadata
parameters.description: Specifies which attributes to export as image metadata.

parameters.label: Artist
parameters.heading: Metadata
parameters.description: The name of the image creator. By default uses the current user's log in name. Houdini, TIFF, PNG formats

parameters.label: Comment
parameters.heading: Metadata
parameters.description: A text comment to include in the output file. Houdini, OpenEXR, PNG formats

parameters.label: Hostname
parameters.heading: Metadata
parameters.description: The name of the computer where this image was created.

parameters.label: MPlay session label
parameters.heading: Metadata
parameters.description: When rendering to MPlay, all Houdini sessions will send the output to the same MPlay flipbook. This can be problematic when running multiple Houdini sessions. The MPlay Label lets you specify a label for the MPlay associated with the output driver. Only renders which match the given label will be sent to that MPlay.

parameters.label: MPlay gamma
parameters.heading: Metadata
parameters.description: Display gamma for MPlay, from `0.0` to `4.0`.

parameters.label: Tile and Generate Mip-Maps
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Writes out the output image as a mipmapped texture map.

parameters.label: Tile Size
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: The width and height of the tiles to use for mipmapping.

parameters.label: Mip-Map Resize Filter
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: The filter to use when down-scaling the image.

parameters.label: Remove Opaque Alpha Channels
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Detects and removes opaque alpha channels when saving textures.

parameters.label: JPEG quality
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: JPEG Quality, integer from `10` to `100`.

parameters.label: TIFF compression
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Type of image compression to use in TIFF files. Possible values are `"None", "LZW", "AdobeDeflate", "Deflate", "PackBits", "JPEG", "PixarLog", "SGILog", "SGILog24", "LZMA", "Zstd"`.

parameters.label: EXR Compression
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Compression type for EXR format images. Possible values are `"none", "rle", "zips", "zip", "piz", "pix", "b44", "b44a", "dwaa", "dwab"`.

parameters.label: DWA Compression Level
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: DWA compression level, integer from `1` to `500`.

parameters.label: PNG/TGA Premultiplication
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: When R, G, and B are the pure color values of a pixel and A is its alpha, this determines whether the values are premultiplied or unpremultiplied.

parameters.label: Pre-Render Script
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Run this script before any rendering.

parameters.label: Pre-Frame Script
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Run this script before each frame.

parameters.label: Post-Frame Script
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Run this script after each frame.

parameters.label: Post-Write Script
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Run this script after each frame's data finishes writing to disk.

parameters.label: Post-Render Script
parameters.heading: Optimization
parameters.description: Run this script after all rendering.

entries.title: Scatter Shapes
entries.summary: Scatters input stamps across the image using randomization controls.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the node outputs. See [Signatures|/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Link Stamps
parameters.description: Makes the __Stamps X__ and __Stamps Y__ values equal.

parameters.label: Stamps X
parameters.description: The amount of stamps to scatter along the X-axis of the image.

parameters.label: Stamps Y
parameters.description: The amount of stamps to scatter along the Y-axis of the image.

parameters.label: Stamps
parameters.description: The amount of stamps to scatter along both the X and Y-axes of the image.

parameters.label: Scatter Seed
parameters.heading: Scattering
parameters.description: The seed value for all randomization that deals with stamp placement. This includes jitter, density, angle and direction, scale, and stretch.

parameters.label: Stamp Scaling
parameters.heading: Scale
parameters.description: The way that the stamps scale in respect to the tile.

parameters.label: Scale Layer Mask
parameters.heading: Scale
parameters.description: The amount of the `scale` input's mono value to mix in with the __Image Scale__ or __Tile Scale__ value, which impacts the stamps' scale. Higher values mix in more of the input's value. Lower values mix in less of the input's value.

parameters.label: Scale Mode
parameters.heading: Scale
parameters.description: The method of post-processing to apply to the scale of stamps.

parameters.label: Image Scale
parameters.heading: Scale
parameters.description: Sets the scale of the stamps in [image space|/copernicus/spaces].

parameters.label: Tile Scale
parameters.heading: Scale
parameters.description: Sets the scale of the stamps in tile space, where a value of `1` is one tile space and a value of `2` is two times a tile space.

parameters.label: Scale Variance
parameters.heading: Scale
parameters.description: The amount of random variance to apply to the scale. This is applied as a post-process. If __Tile Scale__ is `1` and __Scale Variance__ `1` for example, this represents a 100% range in sizes. This means the output stamps have a random scale from `0.5 * Scale` to `2.0 * Scale`.

parameters.label: Min Value
parameters.heading: Scale
parameters.description: The minimum value that the stamps can randomly select, and then multiply against the original __Image Scale__ or __Tile Scale__. This is applied as a post-process.

parameters.label: Max Value
parameters.heading: Scale
parameters.description: The maximum value that the stamps can randomly select, and then multiply against the original __Image Scale__ or __Tile Scale__. This is applied as a post-process.

parameters.label: Jitter Layer Mask
parameters.heading: Jitter
parameters.description: The amount of the `jitter` input's UV value to mix in with the __Jitter__ value, which impacts the random position offset. Higher values mix in more of the input's value. Lower values mix in less of the input's value.

parameters.label: Jitter Layer Strength
parameters.heading: Jitter
parameters.description: The amount by which to multiply the  `jitter` input's UV value.

parameters.label: Post-Jitter
parameters.heading: Jitter
parameters.description: Sample the input layers such as `scale`, `angle`, using the stamps' position post-jitter.

parameters.label: Jitter
parameters.heading: Jitter
parameters.description: The amount of random position offset to add to each point's position on the grid.

parameters.label: Jitter Scale
parameters.heading: Jitter
parameters.description: When the [Smallicon:BUTTONS/decompose_transforms] __Per-Component Controls__ button is on, this is the per-axis scaling of the random position offset for the created stamps.

parameters.label: Angle Layer Mask
parameters.heading: Angle
parameters.description: The amount of the `angle` input's mono value to mix in with the __Angle__ value, which impacts the degree of the stamps' angles. Higher values mix in more of the input's value. Lower values mix in less of the input's value.

parameters.label: Direction Layer Mask
parameters.heading: Angle
parameters.description: The amount of the `direction` input's UV value to mix in with the __Angle__ value, which impacts the direction of the stamps' angles. Higher values mix in more of the input's value. Lower values mix in less of the input's value.

parameters.label: Angle
parameters.heading: Angle
parameters.description: The angle in degrees to rotate each stamp. Use the dropdown menu to set the method of post-processing that applies to the angle of the stamps.

parameters.label: Angle Variance
parameters.heading: Angle
parameters.description: The amount of random variance to apply to the angles. This is applied as a post-process. For example, a value of `30` makes each stamp have a random offset between `-30` degrees and `30` degrees.

parameters.label: Min Value
parameters.heading: Angle
parameters.description: The minimum degree that the stamps can randomly select, and then multiply against the original __Angle__. This is applied as a post-process.

parameters.label: Max Value
parameters.heading: Angle
parameters.description: The maximum degree that the stamps can randomly select, and then multiply against the original __Angle__. This is applied as a post-process.

parameters.label: Round to Multiples
parameters.heading: Angle
parameters.description: Snaps all stamps to a specified angle. This is applied as a post-process.

parameters.label: Stretch Layer Mask
parameters.heading: Stretch
parameters.description: The amount of the `stretch` input's UV value to mix in with the __Stretch X__ and __Stretch Y__ values, which impacts the XY scale. Higher values mix in more of the input's value. Lower values mix in less of the input's value.

parameters.label: Stretch Mode
parameters.heading: Stretch
parameters.description: The method of post-processing to apply to the non-uniform scale (stretch) of stamps.

parameters.label: Random per Component
parameters.heading: Stretch
parameters.description: Randomizes the __Stretch Variance__ and __Min/Max Value__ differently for each X or Y component.

parameters.label: Stretch X
parameters.heading: Stretch
parameters.description: The scale of the stamps along the X-axis that multiplies to the uniform scale.

parameters.label: Stretch Y
parameters.heading: Stretch
parameters.description: The scale of the stamps along the Y-axis that multiplies to the uniform scale.

parameters.label: Stretch Variance
parameters.heading: Stretch
parameters.description: The amount of random variance to apply to the scale of the X and Y-axes. This is applied as a post-process. If __Stretch X__ is `1` and __Stretch Variance__ is `1, 0` for example, this represents a 100% range in sizes. This means the output stamps have a random scale from `0.5 * Stretch X` to `2.0 * Stretch X`.

parameters.label: Min Value
parameters.heading: Stretch
parameters.description: The minimum value that the stamps can randomly select, and then multiply against the original __Stretch X__ and __Stretch Y__. This is applied as a post-process.

parameters.label: Max Value
parameters.heading: Stretch
parameters.description: The maximum value that the stamps can randomly select, and then multiply against the original __Stretch X__ and __Stretch Y__. This is applied as a post-process.

parameters.label: Density Layer Mask
parameters.heading: Density
parameters.description: The amount of the `density` input's mono value to mix in with the __Density__ value, which impacts the rejection sampling. Higher values mix in more of the input's value. Lower values mix in less of the input's value.

parameters.label: Density
parameters.heading: Density
parameters.description: The amount of [rejection sampling|Wp:Rejection_sampling] to apply to the created stamps. For example, a value of `0.8` means that each stamp has a 20% chance to disappear.

parameters.label: Blend Method
parameters.heading: Color and Blending
parameters.description: When mulitple stamps overlap, this controls how they blend together.

parameters.label: Use Sort Layer
parameters.heading: Color and Blending
parameters.description: Multiplies the __Depth-Sorted Over__ or __Unsorted Depth-Weighted Over__ sort values by the `sort` input's value.

parameters.label: Treat Mono as Alpha
parameters.heading: Color and Blending
parameters.description: Makes the expansion from mono to RGBA occur as GGGG, which means that a mono input as a stamp expanded to RGBA produces a darker than usual looking stamp. When off, the default for this node is to expand with GGG1, which means the resulting stamp doesn't look different.

parameters.label: Color Seed
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The seed value for randomization that deals with stamp color and alpha.

parameters.label: Color Layer Mask
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The amount of the `color` input's RGB value to mix in with the __Stamp Color__ value, which impacts the stamps' tint. Higher values mix in more of the input's value. Lower values mix in less of the input's value.

parameters.label: Stamp Color
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: A tint for the stamp. Use the dropdown menu to set how the color applies to the stamps.

parameters.label: Hue
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The amount of random variance to apply to the hue. This is applied as a post-process. If set to `30` for example, the stamps randomly pick a hue offset from the range of `0` to `30`.

parameters.label: Saturation
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The amount of random variance to apply to the saturation. This is applied as a post-process. If set to `0.5` for example, the stamps randomly pick a saturation from the range of `0` to `0.5`.

parameters.label: Value
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The amount of random variance to apply to the value. This is applied as a post-process. If set to `0.5` for example, the stamps randomly pick a value from the range of `0` to `0.5`.

parameters.label: Alpha Layer Mask
parameters.heading: Alpha
parameters.description: The amount of the `alpha` input's mono value to mix in with the __Stamp Alpha__ value, which impacts the stamps' alpha. Higher values mix in more of the input's value. Lower values mix in less of the input's value.

parameters.label: Stamp Alpha
parameters.heading: Alpha
parameters.description: The amount of black (`0`) and white (`1`) by which to multiply the stamp's alpha. Use the dropdown menu to set how the alpha applies to the stamps.

parameters.label: Alpha Variance
parameters.heading: Alpha
parameters.description: The amount of random variance to apply to the alpha. This is applied as a post-process.

parameters.label: Background Color
parameters.heading: Background
parameters.description: The initial background color of the space around the stamps.

parameters.label: Background Alpha
parameters.heading: Background
parameters.description: The initial background alpha of the space around the stamps.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.heading: Stamp Selection
parameters.description: The stamps to place in the image. When no `stamps` input is wired in, this parameter applies to the default star pattern.

parameters.label: Limit Selection
parameters.heading: Stamp Selection
parameters.description: Limits the maximum number of stamps that the node uses.

parameters.label: Select Seed
parameters.heading: Stamp Selection
parameters.description: The seed value for random stamp selection.

parameters.label: Do Tiled
parameters.heading: Grid
parameters.description: When enabled, the __Grid Angle__ gets clamped to `90 degrees`, and the Grid Offset and Scale are snapped to a divisor of the __Stamps X or Y__. For example, if your __Stamps X__ was `10`, your __Grid Offset__ will snap to increments of `0.1`, in order to not have a stamp cut off on the edge of an image.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.heading: Grid
parameters.description: Grid Scale in [image space|/copernicus/spaces].

parameters.label: Offset
parameters.heading: Grid
parameters.description: Grid Offset in [image space|/copernicus/spaces].

parameters.label: Angle
parameters.heading: Grid
parameters.description: Grid Rotation in Degrees.

entries.title: Sharpen
entries.summary: Sharpens an input layer to increase the definition of its edges.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the source accepts. See [Signatures|/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Mask
parameters.description: The amount of the new value to mix in with the original value. Higher values mix in more of the new value. Lower values mix in less of the new value. The default value is `1`, which means this node uses only the new value. See [Mask|/copernicus/glossary#mask] for more information.

parameters.label: Units
parameters.description: The unit of measurement that the Blur COP in the node's subnetwork uses to determine the size of the sharpen effect's radius.

parameters.label: Read Pixels outside Image
parameters.description: Adds contributions from pixels outside of the image. This depends on the [border type|/copernicus/glossary#border], which determines what pixels to read as outside of the image.

parameters.label: Size
parameters.description: The size of the sharpen effect's radius in image space or pixels, which the __Units__ parameter determines. Higher values expand the circumference of the radius to enhance the crispness of the sharpen effect. Lower values contract the circumference of the radius to add softness and remove the sharpen effect.

parameters.label: Scale Size
parameters.description: The amount to scale the sharpen effect's radius.

parameters.label: Amplitude
parameters.description: The amount by which to multiply the original layer's pixels by the unsharp mask. Higher values increase the sharpen effect, while lower values remove the sharpen effect.

parameters.label: Gain
parameters.description: The amount by which to multiply the brightness of the original layer's pixels. Set this parameter to `0` and __Amplitude__ to a positive value to generate a high-pass filter.

parameters.label: Threshold
parameters.description: The difference in pixel value between the original layer and its unsharp mask that's required for the node to sharpen the layer. Higher values help remove high frequency noise that you might not want to sharpen.

entries.title: Slope Direction
entries.summary: Converts a height layer into a direction layer.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the source accepts. See [Signatures|/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Space
parameters.description: The [space|/copernicus/spaces] in which to compute the slope. This affects the magnitude of the directions. This may also affect the directions themselves if pixels are anisotropically scaled in the provided space.

parameters.label: Angle
parameters.description: After computing the slope direction, rotate it by this amount.  By setting to 90 you will get directions that avoid going up slope and instead circumnavigate hills.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.description: Heights are often not to scale, so this adjusts the direction's magnitude globally to get into a useful value.

parameters.label: Read Pixels outside Image
parameters.description: Determine if derivatives at the boundary should read outside the image or restrict to the image range.  Reading outside is useful for building seamless textures with wrap-mode.  But restricting to the image range avoids artificial flattening of the derivative at the boundary in clamp modes, as it acts more like an extrapolation.

parameters.label: Kernel Size
parameters.description: Usually a derivative is computed with adjacent pixels, but if the values are slowly varying there may not be enough bit-detph to get smooth derivatives.  This will expand the distance, in buffer elements, to compute the derivative, possibly removing stepping artifacts from the derivative.

entries.title: Solve Poisson
entries.summary: Solves Poisson's equation inside a 2D boundary.

parameters.label: Iterations
parameters.description: The number of solver iterations to perform. Higher values produce a more converged solution, but take longer to compute.

parameters.label: Boundary Blend
parameters.description: Blends between the __Dirichlet__ and __Neumann__ boundary conditions. A value of `0` uses Dirichlet boundary values, and a value of `1` uses Neumann boundary values. When the `blend` input is wired, that input overrides this parameter.

parameters.label: Iterations
parameters.heading: Pre-conditioner
parameters.description: The number of pre-conditioner iterations to perform during the solve. Higher values can improve convergence, but increase cook time.

parameters.label: Smoothing Iterations
parameters.heading: Pre-conditioner
parameters.description: The number of smoothing iterations to perform in the pre-conditioner. Higher values can improve the pre-conditioned approximation.

parameters.label: Coarsest Smoothing Iterations
parameters.heading: Pre-conditioner
parameters.description: The number of smoothing iterations to perform at the coarsest level of the pre-conditioner, in place of an exact coarse solve.

entries.title: Sphere Sample
entries.summary: Samples a layer onto a sphere.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the source accepts. See [Signatures|/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Filter
parameters.description: The method used to sample the source layer.

parameters.label: Transform Order
parameters.description: The order in which the transform components are applied when __Celestial Sphere__ is off.

parameters.label: Rotation Order
parameters.description: The order in which rotations around the X, Y, and Z axes are applied.

parameters.label: Celestial Sphere
parameters.description: Samples the source as a sphere at infinity. When on, only __Rotate__ affects the sampled direction, and the mask is `1` everywhere.

parameters.label: Projection
parameters.description: The projection used to sample the transformable sphere when __Celestial Sphere__ is off.

parameters.label: Translate
parameters.description: Moves the sampled sphere in 3D space when __Celestial Sphere__ is off.

parameters.label: Rotate
parameters.description: Rotates the sampled sphere, in degrees.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.description: Scales the sampled sphere independently along each axis when __Celestial Sphere__ is off.

parameters.label: Uniform Scale

entries.title: Stamp Points
entries.summary: Stamps layers from point positions.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the source accepts. See [Signatures|/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Background Color
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The initial background color.

parameters.label: Background Alpha
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The initial background alpha.

parameters.label: Stamp Color
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: A tint for the stamp.

parameters.label: Stamp Alpha
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: A scale for the stamped alpha.  This is multiplied by both an `Alpha` and a `blend` attribute.

parameters.label: Shape
parameters.heading: Clipping
parameters.description: If a `clipshape` is not provided, this determines the shape of the stamp.  If it is provided, it is treated as an SDF and the zero contour will determine the cut out shape.

parameters.label: Scale
parameters.heading: Clipping
parameters.description: A uniform scale for the stamped values.  This is multiplied by a `pscale` attribute.

parameters.label: Angle
parameters.heading: Clipping
parameters.description: An angle in degrees to rotate the stamps by.  This is added to a `spriterot` for the final angle.

parameters.label: Shape Edge Filter
parameters.heading: Clipping
parameters.description: A filter-scale to apply for filtering the edge of the cutout of a stamped shape.  Zero will make it all or nothing but result in aliasing, `1` will do the expected level of aliasing for the current resolution.

parameters.label: Shape Falloff
parameters.heading: Clipping
parameters.description: How much into the shape the falloff region should extend.

parameters.label: Space
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: The mode in which the transform attributes on the `points` input are interpreted: 2D or 3D.

parameters.label: Instancing Attributes
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: Attributes in Houdini can specify instancing either through `sprite` attributes, such as with the [Sprite SOP|Node:/sop/sprite], or through the standard copy and transform attributes.

parameters.label: Up Axis
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: When converting standard instancing attributes, you must know which axis maps to "up" on the stamp.

parameters.label: Rotation from
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: Which axis is read out to determine the effective rotation, as they may not be consistent in the case of shears, etc.

parameters.label: Z Falloff
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: When __Space__ is set to __World Space__, this is the Z-falloff for the stamp-space's depth (the Z coordinate). As the absolute value of this parameter approaches the Z-falloff, the alpha is multilplied by a factor that tends to 0. When `0`, this effect is off (the Z-falloff becomes infinite).

parameters.label: Number of Stamps
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: The number of possible stamps to use.  These are indexed from zero with the `stamp` attribute.

parameters.label: Filter Scale
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: The amount by which to multiply the `pos` input. Higher values indicate that the target pixels take up more world space. This means that when a stamp is applied on top of those target pixels, more pixels in the stamp have to be sampled to cover the footprint of every target pixel in stamp space.

parameters.label: Filter
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: The method used to sample the image. The default value is `Box`. See [Filters|/copernicus/glossary#filter] for more information.

parameters.label: Blend Method
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: When mulitple stamps overlap, this controls how they blend together.

parameters.label: Sort Stamps by Depth
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: Sorts the stamps based on their depth.

parameters.label: Wrap Mode
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: The wrapping behavior of the stamps.

parameters.label: Tile Size
parameters.heading: Options
parameters.description: When __Wrap Mode__ is `Auto` or `On`, this is the size (in [image space|/copernicus/spaces]) of the region to wrap into. The resultant image periodically repeats in this size.

entries.title: Star Glow
entries.summary: Streaks the layer multiple times in different directions to create a star effect.

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the source accepts. See [Signatures|/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Mask
parameters.description: The amount of the new value to mix in with the original value. Higher values mix in more of the new value. Lower values mix in less of the new value. The default value is `1`, which means this node uses only the new value. See [Mask|/copernicus/glossary#mask] for more information.

parameters.label: Threshold
parameters.description: Any pixel with a luminance value above this threshold has the star glow effect. This lets you apply star glow to only high luminance parts of your source layer. You can also use the `effect` input with this parameter to select where the effect happens.

parameters.label: Width
parameters.description: The range (in [image space|/copernicus/spaces]) on both sides of the __Threshold__ that determines the input minimum and maximum.

parameters.label: Border
parameters.description: The sampling behavior outside of the incoming layer's boundaries. Automatically uses the layer's border property. See [Border types|/copernicus/glossary#border] for more information.

parameters.label: Output Star Glow Only
parameters.description: Outputs only the star glow effect, which displays a preview of the effect. Turn this on if you want to make the star glow a separate AOV or configure the star glow further before you composite it on top of the source layer.

parameters.label: Streaks
parameters.heading: Star Glow
parameters.description: The amount of streaks in the layer. Each new streak takes up a space in 360 degrees. A value of `2` means each streak is 180 degrees offset from each other. A value of `6` means each streak is 60 degrees offset from each other.

parameters.label: Streak Length
parameters.heading: Star Glow
parameters.description: The overall strength (in image space) of the streaks. Negative values follow the directions backwards when tracing.

parameters.label: Brightness
parameters.heading: Star Glow
parameters.description: The amount of brightness to apply to the star glow effect. Higher values increase the brightness to lighten and expand the star glow effect. Lower values decrease the brightness to dim and shrink the star glow effect.

parameters.label: Angle
parameters.heading: Star Glow
parameters.description: The degree by which to offset the direction of all streaks.

parameters.label: Streak
parameters.heading: Star Glow
parameters.description: The method used to combine the pixel values along the direction of distortion.

parameters.label: Streak Weight
parameters.heading: Star Glow
parameters.description: This ramp acts as a multiplier on the pixel values when streaking. The left side of the ramp corresponds to the start of the trajectory. For example, when the __Streak__ is `Blur`, the default linear ramp fades the pixels over their path. This makes the pixels more faint near the start. For more information about using ramps, see [Ramp parameters|/network/ramps].

parameters.label: Combine Streaks with
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The blending operation used to combine the streaks before they're added onto the original layer. The node doesn't add the combined streaks onto the original layer when __Output Star Glow Only__ is on.

parameters.label: Color Mode
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The method used to color the streaks.

parameters.label: Multiply with Original
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: Multiplies the selected color with the color of the pixels in the original layer. When off, the selected color replaces the original layer's color.

parameters.label: Color
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The color to apply to all streaks.

parameters.label: Azimuth
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The direction in degrees to cycle the ramp across each streak.

parameters.label: Color Ramp
parameters.heading: Color
parameters.description: The ramp to apply across each streak. See [Ramp parameters|/network/ramps] for more information.

parameters.label: Aberration
parameters.heading: Aberration
parameters.description: Splits each streak into separate RGB streaks and composites them together. Each channel streak contributes to the final alpha when in RGBA mode.

parameters.label: Red
parameters.heading: Aberration
parameters.description: The amount (in degrees) to rotate the red channel by this angle. Higher values rotate the channel in a counterclockwise direction, which makes the offset between the channels more apparent. Lower values rotate the channel in a clockwise direction.

parameters.label: Green
parameters.heading: Aberration
parameters.description: The amount (in degrees) to rotate the green channel by this angle. Higher values rotate the channel in a counterclockwise direction, which makes the offset between the channels more apparent. Lower values rotate the channel in a clockwise direction.

parameters.label: Blue
parameters.heading: Aberration
parameters.description: The amount (in degrees) to rotate the blue channel by this angle. Higher values rotate the channel in a counterclockwise direction, which makes the offset between the channels more apparent. Lower values rotate the channel in a clockwise direction.

parameters.label: Glimmer
parameters.heading: Glimmer
parameters.description: Applies noise to the streak lengths, which can create a subtle glimmering and shimmering effect.

parameters.label: Glimmer Strength
parameters.heading: Glimmer
parameters.description: The amount that the noise affects (multiplies against) the streak lengths.

parameters.label: Glimmer Size
parameters.heading: Glimmer
parameters.description: The size (in image space) of the basic element of the noise.

parameters.label: Maximum Steps
parameters.heading: Advanced
parameters.description: The maximum number of steps taken in the streak. Higher streak lengths can cause gaps, so increase this parameter to fill these gaps.

entries.title: Streak Blur
entries.summary: Streaks an image, adding a motion blur effect.

parameters.label: Mask
parameters.description: The amount of the new value to mix in with the original value. Higher values mix in more of the new value. Lower values mix in less of the new value. A value of `1` means this node uses only the new value. The default value is `1`. See [Mask|/copernicus/glossary#mask] for more information.

parameters.label: Border
parameters.description: The sampling behavior outside of the incoming layer's boundaries. Automatically uses the layer's border property. See [Border types|/copernicus/glossary#border] for more information.

parameters.label: Direction Type
parameters.description: Whether the streak angle is specified directly as an angle or through polar coordinates.

parameters.label: Angle
parameters.description: Specifies the streak direction (0 is horizontal, 90 vertical).

parameters.label: Direction
parameters.description: Specifies the streak direction in polar coordinates (1 0 is rightwards, 0 1 is upwards). If normalize direction is off, these will be multipled by the length to provide the effective length.

parameters.label: Normalise Direction
parameters.description: Whether to multiply the length by the magnitude of the direction vector to provide the effective length.

parameters.label: Units
parameters.description: Sets the effect's area units.

parameters.label: Length
parameters.description: Sets the length of the streaks according to the units set.

parameters.label: Bias
parameters.description: Determines how the streak is centered on the pixel creating the streak. To center the streak around the pixel, use 0. To make the streak end at the pixel, use -1 (the streak comes before the pixel that generates it). To make the streak begin at the pixel, use 1.

parameters.label: Mode
parameters.description: The method used to combine the pixel values along the line.

parameters.label: Use Streak Weight
parameters.description: Weight the samples encountered along the path. Use __Streak Weight__ to weaken the values over the trajectory.

parameters.label: Streak Weight
parameters.description: When __Use Streak Weight__ is on, this ramp acts as a multiplier on the pixel values when streaking. The left side of the ramp corresponds to the start of the trajectory. For example, when the __Mode__ is `Blur`, the default linear ramp fades the pixels over their path. This makes the pixels more faint near the start. For more information about using ramps, see [Ramp parameters|/network/ramps].

parameters.label: Signature
parameters.description: The layer type that the source accepts. See [Signatures |/copernicus/glossary#signatures] for more information.

parameters.label: Wrap Mode
parameters.description: The wrapping behavior of the deformation at the boundary.

parameters.label: Filter
parameters.description: The filter used to sample the source layer when the swirl deformation reads between pixels. See [Filters|/copernicus/glossary#filter] for more information.

parameters.label: Tile Size
parameters.description: The size of the base deformation region.

parameters.label: Parameter Mode
parameters.description: Set whether to use the uniform or random parameters.

parameters.label: Translation
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The amount in [image space|/copernicus/spaces] to translate the deformation regions.

parameters.label: Strength
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The strength with which to apply the spiral deformation. Positive values create a counterclockwise spiral and negative values create a clockwise spiral.

parameters.label: Bulge
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The amount of deformation to apply along radial directions from the center. This produces lens distortion deformation.

parameters.label: Radius
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The radius of the deformation, which defines the actual distance from each swirl's center in image space.

parameters.label: Blend Region
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The radius of the blended region between the deformed area and the background. This specifies the distance (in image space) from the boundary that the __Radius__ parameter defines.

parameters.label: Inner Radius
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The radius of the undeformed center region inside each swirl.

parameters.label: Inner Blend Region
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The size of the blended region between the undeformed center and the swirled area.

parameters.label: Rotate
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The amount in degrees to rotate the areas that the __Bulge__ and __Strength__ parameters deform. This parameter allows for full control over the ellipses orientation.

parameters.label: Roundness
parameters.heading: Uniform controls
parameters.description: The elliptical shape of the deformation. A value of `1` produces a circular (disk-shaped) deformation. Values less than `1` create elliptical shapes, where the Y-axis is the semi-major axis and the X-axis is the semi-minor axis.

parameters.label: Seed
parameters.heading: Randomize
parameters.description: The seed used to generate the random numbers.

parameters.label: Activate Position Random
parameters.heading: Randomize
parameters.description: Enables random offsets for swirl center positions.

parameters.label: Central Position
parameters.heading: Randomize
parameters.description: The center point (mean) of the random position offsets.

parameters.label: Central Value
parameters.heading: Randomize
parameters.description: The center point (mean) of the randomized swirl parameters.

parameters.label: Scatter
parameters.heading: Randomize
parameters.description: The standard deviation of randomized parameter offsets.

parameters.label: Number of Points
